thread:
mike_release: FYI — planning a controlled weight shift for eu-west tonight at 22:00 UTC. Purpose: deploy redis-backed session cookie pin and validate no session loss. Will do blue->green with staged weights. Need SRE + oncall + router eng to ack.
sara_sre: acked. I'll be online for the window. what's the initial canary weight? :eyes:
mike_release: start at 5% for 10m, then 20% for 15m, 50% for 10m, then 100% drain. If errors or session loss >1% revert immediately.
anna_ops: quick question — are we changing cookie name or just pin behavior? we don't want to invalidate existing cookies.
ben_platform: we'll keep cookie name but attach `x-session-pin=v2` flag in the router so both versions coexist. plan: router will honor v2 when present, else fall back to v1. no mass invalidation.
emily_pmgr: added to change window calendar: 2026-03-20T22:00Z. release notes link -> https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-20/session-pin (drafted) :memo:
deploy-bot: Deploy checklist: steps: 1) push router config canary 5% 2) wait 10m health checks 3) increase weights 4) drain blue pool 5) verify sticky sessions 6) promote. Run `/deploy start --tag session-pin-20260320` to kick off.
router-bot: Router plan prepared. Commands for ops below. Use these to change weights and drain:
```bash
# set weights
curl -X POST https://router-api.redwood/weights -d '{"service":"eu-west","green":5,"blue":95}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'

# drain blue
curl -X POST https://router-api.redwood/drain -d '{"pool":"eu-west-blue","grace":300}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'
```
anna_ops: we'll also pin session affinity on the LB level for 30m after shift to catch lingering sessions. router supports cookie + lb affinity; doing both for safety.
sara_sre: monitoring: I'll add a short-lived eval to check session continuity across sticks: compare cookie_id counts before/after and check 502/5xx + session-drop metric. alert if session_drop_rate > 1% or 5xx > 0.5%.
ben_platform: can we do a quick smoke run on stage with synthetic users to validate sticky behavior? takes ~15m.
mike_release: yes, run smoke at 20:30 UTC. If green, we'll proceed at 22:00. If failures appear during the 5->20 step, we hold and escalate.
emily_pmgr: stakeholder comms: I'll ping CS and marketing (brief note) once we hit 50% to avoid customer surprises.
deploy-bot: Rollback policy: if SLO degradation or session loss threshold exceeded, immediate weight rollback to previous stable values and cancel drain. Use `/deploy rollback --tag session-pin-20260320` to revert.
sara_sre: one more: we should capture a router config snapshot before changes. `router-bot` can produce it.
router-bot: snapshot created: snap-2310987654. Stored at https://internal.redwood/router/snapshots/snap-2310987654
anna_ops: noted. I'll be on `#eng-oncall` during the window and will coordinate drain timers.
ben_platform: small note: sticky sessions hide some load balancing issues. post-migration follow-up: run a 24h heap of traffic to ensure no session skew.
mike_release: agreed. after 100% we keep both cookie handlers active for 7 days and then retire v1 when safe. adding to release notes.
emily_pmgr: all acked. emoji :white_check_mark: from PM side.
sara_sre: smoke run at 20:30 happened — stage looks good. session continuity 0.02% drops. ready for 22:00.
mike_release: starting now. initiating 5% canary.
router-bot: weights updated -> green:5% blue:95% by operator mike_release
deploy-bot: health checks passing at 5%. waiting 10m before next bump.
[10 minutes pass]
router-bot: bumping weights -> green:20% blue:80%
sara_sre: monitoring: no session-drop alarms. 5xx steady at baseline. proceed to 50% in 15m.
router-bot: bumping weights -> green:50% blue:50%
emily_pmgr: pinged CS + marketing about partial roll.
sara_sre: still good. session continuity at 0.03% drops, within thresholds. moving to full shift in 10m.
mike_release: initiating drain of blue pool after 10m steady.
router-bot: drain command queued: `/drain pool-eu-west-blue --grace 300`
anna_ops: LB affinity pinned for 30m as discussed.
[drain completes]
router-bot: blue pool drained and removed from rotation. green at 100%.
sara_sre: final checks: session_drop_rate 0.04% over window, 5xx nominal. Promoting config to stable.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. snapshot snap-2310987654 tagged as 'post-cutover'.
mike_release: nice work team. leaving v1 cookie handler active for 7d before cleanup. Closing window and updating release notes.
emily_pmgr: I'll publish the final release note and send recap in #announcements.
ben_platform: one follow-up ticket: PLT-1298 to remove v1 handler after audit.
sara_sre: closing monitoring playbook. If anything spikes, we revert to snapshot snap-2310987654 and run rollback flow.
mike_release: thanks all :tada:
